A '''Plasma Generator''' was part of the systems installed aboard the [[Sun Crusher]]. It was located in the tapered point of the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], close to the [[resonance energizer]] and [[resonance projector]].<ref name="EGWT" />
